scope: Finite native AWS observations on four owned empty 1-GiB sources. Eleven copy target IDs were accepted, seven completed, three terminal errors were observed, and one revoked-source target was deleted before terminal DescribeSnapshots. Not a general parity claim.

fixtures.copy_controls.json: Admission, duplicate/default copies, source sharing/revoke, lifecycle, native EventBridge and delivered two-account management CloudTrail. Initial owner IAM base policy masks session cases; use corrected IAM fixture.
fixtures.copy_controls_iam.json: Corrected region-bounded owner role; source/destination resource checks, resource-account/Owner/SourceRegion conditions, CreateTags authority, successful copy while DescribeSnapshots and EBS reads are explicitly denied.
fixtures.copy_controls_source_authority.json: Actual recipient CopySnapshot with exact source-resource explicit deny: UnauthorizedOperation, no target created.
fixtures.copy_controls_public.json: One public source and recipient copy, under pre-existing unblocked setting; copy completes and stays EBS-readable after public reset.
fixtures.copy_controls_contexts.json: Read-only split source/destination session-policy conditions against the public fixture source.

contracts.required: Absent SourceSnapshotId returns MissingParameter: The request must contain the parameter SourceSnapshotId. With id provided, absent SourceRegion returned InternalError: An internal error has occurred. Both were observed with and without DryRun.
contracts.source_id: Empty, bad, and snap-00000000000000000 each return InvalidParameterValue: The specified snapshotId is invalid, before IAM and DryRun.
contracts.source_region: Empty and not-a-region return InvalidRegion: <value> is not a valid region name. Valid us-west-2 for an actual us-east-1 source accepts a new target then errors Source snapshot is not found.
contracts.destination_region: Explicit us-west-2 or not-a-region at the us-east-1 endpoint passes DryRun. Actual mismatch returns InvalidParameterValue: DestinationRegion 'us-west-2' does not match the current region (us-east-1).
contracts.source_admission: Pending source and unshared recipient source accept new target IDs. Pending source then errors Source snapshot is not complete; inaccessible/wrong-region source then errors Source snapshot is not found. Their DryRun calls return DryRunOperation.
contracts.duplicates_and_metadata: Repeated minimal requests yield distinct IDs. Default Description is empty, not inherited. Source tags and create-volume permissions are not inherited; explicit requested tags appear in CopySnapshot Tags and pending/completed DescribeSnapshots.
contracts.pending: Immediate pending copies have StateMessage Metadata not updated, VolumeId vol-ffffffff, VolumeSize 0, Encrypted false, Progress 0%, StorageTier standard, TransferType standard, and explicit tags/description already present.
contracts.completed: Completed empty 1-GiB copies have VolumeSize 1, Progress 100%, CompletionTime and FullSnapshotSizeInBytes 0; StateMessage absent. Error copies retain VolumeSize 0, Progress 0% and their error StateMessage, without CompletionTime/full-size fields.
contracts.duration: 15-minute copy completed with TransferType time-based and CompletionDurationMinutes 15. 15/2880 pass DryRun. -1/0/1/14/16/2881 return InvalidParameterValue, requiring values between 15 and 2880 in 15 minute increments, before IAM/DryRun.
contracts.iam_resources: Both destination arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1::snapshot/* and exact source arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1::snapshot/snap-ID require ec2:CopySnapshot. Source-only, destination-only NotResource source, and explicit source deny reject. Explicit source deny also rejects a real recipient copy before creating a target.
contracts.iam_contexts: aws:ResourceAccount is requester on destination and owner on source: individually constraining every resource to either account rejects recipient copy, while split statements matching both succeed. Source-only ec2:Owner=source owner succeeds; wrong Owner rejects. A blanket Owner condition rejects at destination. ec2:SourceRegion match rejects on both tested destination and isolated source.
contracts.tag_authority: Tags require ec2:CreateTags on destination. ec2:CreateAction=CopySnapshot succeeds; CreateSnapshot or absent tag permission rejects. Real tagged copy completed. Invalid tag resource type and duplicate key reject before DryRun.
contracts.unneeded_reads: A real owner copy completed despite explicit ec2:DescribeSnapshots and ebs:ListSnapshotBlocks/GetSnapshotBlock/ListChangedBlocks denies.
contracts.revoke_and_public: Recipient private-shared copy remains readable after source share revoke; owner source remains readable. Public recipient copy completed under existing unblocked state and remains EBS-readable after public reset; owner source also remains readable.
contracts.eventbridge: Native EBS Snapshot Notification resources/snapshot_id/source actually use arn:aws:ec2::REGION:snapshot/ID. request-id is empty and incremental is a STRING. Successful standard and time-based copies include completionDurationStartTime; time-based has transferType time-based and metCompletionDuration STRING true. Tested source failures have transferType standard, incremental STRING false and no completionDurationStartTime; cause matches snapshot StateMessage.
contracts.cloudtrail: CopySnapshot is a write Management event with destination awsRegion. All 164 delivered CopySnapshot records in this corpus omit resources. Successful responseElements contain requestId and snapshotId, plus tagSet.items when tagged; request tagSpecificationSet.items uses lower-case resourceType/key/value. Positive cross-account source-owner/caller pairs share requestID/sharedEventID; owner userIdentity is AWSAccount identifying requester, caller is AssumedRole. recipientAccountId follows delivery account. Source-owner projection hides tagged request tagSpecificationSet and response tagSet as HIDDEN_DUE_TO_SECURITY_REASONS; recipient sees tag items.

boundaries: Initial owner-session IAM results are masked by a base ec2:SourceRegion condition; only corrected copy_controls_iam.json establishes owner session authority.

Initial run hit transport ConnectionClosedError before observed public-source-add response and during trail cleanup. Snapshots, role and event targets were cleaned, then audit-only recovery harvested and removed both trails/buckets. Public behavior was independently completed on fresh owned source.
PresignedUrl malformed and empty cases only establish DryRun admission here; real encrypted/signature outcomes belong to copy_data fixtures.
Observed propagation and completion times are not service latency guarantees.
Missing eventual CloudTrail/EventBridge records do not establish absence; supplemental IAM copy records were not all delivered within the bounded harvest.
No account/default/org/standing-role changes; no customer KMS keys, volumes, instances, real data, or persistent credentials were created by this script.
